text: When for their own ambitious ends they shun binding themselves, it is a token that they are giving more thought to themselves than to you, and a prince ought to guard against such, and to fear them as if they were open enemies, because in adversity they always help to ruin him.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
locator: Chapter IX, Concerning a civil principality
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
